test.name: Person Tax Lookup Should Return Data From Tax Service Stub

kw.name: Reset Request Log
kw.doc: Resets all logged requests on the wiremock server.

test.doc: John Smith (id 1) has TAX_ID TAX-1001. The person service asks the tax service for it, and WireMock's answer comes back unchanged.

kw.doc: Removes all the session objects

kw.name: Terminate Process

suite.doc: Tests the person service's tax lookup (GET /persons/{id}/tax) with the TaxInformation service replaced by WireMock, which always answers with tax_id "mock_tax_number". Requires the customer DB (run.py) at http://127.0.0.1:8000 and Java on PATH. The real tax service (run_tax.py) must NOT be running: WireMock takes its port, 8001, which is where the person service looks for it.
